import numpy as np
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage,dendrogram,fcluster
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
z=np.load('donor_aggregate.npz',allow_pickle=True)
names=z['donor_names']; ids=np.array([int(x[5:]) for x in names])
S=z['gene_sum']; lib=z['donor_lib']; cells=z['donor_cells']; genes=z['gene_names']
cpm=S/lib[:,None]*1e6
# log CPM pseudobulk, variable genes; exclude sex/ribo/mt/ig/tcr and sparse
L=np.log1p(cpm)
var=L.var(0); mean=L.mean(0)
exclude=np.array([g.startswith(('MT-','RPL','RPS','IGH','IGK','IGL','TRAV','TRBV','TRDV','TRGV')) for g in genes])
keep=(mean>0.1)&(var>np.quantile(var[mean>0.1],.5))&~exclude
X=StandardScaler().fit_transform(L[:,keep])
p=PCA().fit_transform(X)
print('PCA variance',PCA().fit(X).explained_variance_ratio_[:6])
for i in np.argsort(ids): print(f'{ids[i]:2d}',*(f'{x:7.2f}' for x in p[i,:5]))
for method in ['ward','average','complete']:
 Z=linkage(X,method=method,metric='euclidean' if method=='ward' else 'correlation')
 leaves=dendrogram(Z,no_plot=True)['leaves']
 print(method,' '.join(str(ids[i]) for i in leaves))
 for k in [2,3,4,5]:
  lab=fcluster(Z,k,criterion='maxclust')
  print('k',k,' | '.join(','.join(map(str,sorted(ids[lab==x]))) for x in np.unique(lab)))

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
z=np.load('donor_aggregate.npz',allow_pickle=True); G=z['gene_names']; S=z['gene_sum']; lib=z['donor_lib']; names=z['donor_names']; ids=np.array([int(x[5:]) for x in names]); cpm=S/lib[:,None]*1e6
sets={
'IFN':['ISG15','IFI6','IFI27','IFI44L','IFIT1','IFIT3','MX1','OAS1','RSAD2','XAF1','USP18'],
'Neut':['S100A8','S100A9','S100A12','FCGR3B','CSF3R','MNDA'],
'Mono':['LYZ','LST1','FCN1','CTSS','CTSD','TYMP','LGALS3'],
'HLA2':['HLA-DRA','HLA-DPA1','HLA-DPB1','CD74'],
'Plasma':['JCHAIN','MZB1','IGHG1','SDC1'],
'Platelet':['PPBP','PF4','GP9'],
'T':['CD3D','CD3E','TRAC','IL7R','CCR7','LTB'],
'NK':['NKG7','GNLY','KLRD1','PRF1','GZMB','GZMH'],
'Inflam':['IL1B','TNF','NFKBIA','FOS','JUN','DUSP1'],
}
df=pd.DataFrame({'id':ids})
for k,gs in sets.items():
 ix=[np.where(G==g)[0][0] for g in gs if np.any(G==g)]
 df[k]=cpm[:,ix].sum(1)
# log then z within score
for k in sets: df[k+'z']=(np.log1p(df[k])-np.log1p(df[k]).mean())/np.log1p(df[k]).std()
df=df.sort_values('id')
print(df[['id']+list(sets)].to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda x:f'{x:8.1f}'))
print('\\nz')
print(df[['id']+[x+'z' for x in sets]].to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda x:f'{x:6.2f}'))
PY"
